+## G12–G14 bounded release verification
+
+G12 bounds each connection's queued plus Netty-owned work to one FULL, one DELTA and64 ordered messages. Superseded queued buffers are released; incomplete Netty-owned buffers are never mutated or released by the queue. G13 routes independent Room models, clocks and bounded mailboxes inside one server; the registry limits remain64 Rooms and512 connections. Their original failed attempts and fresh repairs remain in `evidence/G12-verification.md` and `evidence/G13-verification.md`.
+
+`./track scenario-run /absolute/G14.json /absolute/result.json` runs the installed release JAR with test-only instrumentation: one32-Room/128-player/600-tick live process, followed by31 separate600-tick accepted-journal replay processes. The requested result is a compact manifest; streamed raw inputs, snapshots, tick states, accepted journals, measurements and replay results are under `result-artifacts/` beside it. Default JFR is off. `--ledger /absolute/commands.jsonl` appends to an explicitly prepared worker ledger; otherwise the coordinator creates an artifact-local ledger. `--jfr /absolute/capture.jfr` enables the one pre-resolved in-process capture, with fixed privacy overrides and a32MiB recording retention cap. Stop/dump/close occurs before every replay process. CPU/heap/GC observations cover the live JVM including its harness; RSS uses five separately recorded and reaped `ps` children.
+
+Workers must invoke this command through the frozen main-owned `g14_load_slot.py` launcher, using only their baseline, profiled and worker-final slots. Root owns the sole main-final slot. Each slot consumes19,200 live and18,600 offline ticks; warm runs remain0. The slow client's test-only readiness proxy consults the actual ordered FIFO and denies only snapshot transfer, preserving all600 real INPUT_ACKs. Raw queue-owned FULL301 and299 superseded-buffer releases are observed without retaining, moving or rewriting buffers. G14 adds no production behavior; see `evidence/G14-command-ledger.jsonl` and `evidence/G14-verification.md` for the unchanged baseline, profile, exact budgets and final evidence. Phase-1 ends atG14; no phase-2 feature or external infrastructure is included.

+# G14 verification — industry-java
+
+START `59fb24ec09d0ed6aabab06dde496497ec2acc4f9`; profile `realtime-core`; Spec-Revision `c1d62196ab76b55652f5d75a67514f8c6d8210ce`.
+Frozen fixture SHA-256: `9e3045a578683cab48abe838a71336b457863811098228462153df7c512b5e6d`.
+
+**NOT_REPRODUCED; zero production changes.** The unchanged G13 implementation satisfies the complete G14 fixture. All18 production files and all61 frozen source files stayed byte-identical across baseline, profiled and worker-final. The installed release JAR SHA-256 is `959c940416c94c152d8a1c72496a0936c2bc14c36a8259fb1838cce27f18054b`. Test-only instrumentation, a zero-tick prerequisite test, production-JAR exclusion assertions, the G14 coordinator and guide are the only additions.
+
+## Results and budget
+
+All three authorized worker slots exited0. Each executed19,200 live ticks and31 separate accepted-journal replay processes totaling18,600 ticks. Every live Room's600 canonical hashes also agree across the three executions. Each run received76,800 actual INPUT_ACKs,600/player, plus38,228 applied/ACKed snapshots:301 for each of127 healthy clients and1 for the held client. The slow player stayed CONNECTED. Its original final queued message is FULL301/tick599: generated301, sent1, coalesced299, superseded releases299, FULL1/DELTA0. All300 observed original slow buffers reach refCnt0 at shutdown. Another114,900 post-initialization original writes complete/refCnt0; ownership violations0. Every Room, socket, parser/input/transport buffer, queue, replay store, snapshot cache, owned thread and clock is released; each run's32 Java children and5 RSS children are recorded/reaped.
+
+Actual consumption: compiler tasks3/8; unit invocations2/4 (full48 + focused zero-tick1, all pass); integration1/2 (4 pass); worker live slots3/3; one JFR capture; two fixed offline JFR inspection commands; warm0; repairs0. No hidden G14 campaign runs in the suites. Root's sole main-final slot remains reserved. Total worker Room ticks:57,600 live +55,800 offline.
+
+## Measurements and no-change decision
+
+Samples occur after initialization, ticks200/400/600 and actual owner-terminated cleanup. The table uses initialization→cleanup sample deltas; CPU covers the live JVM including the same streaming harness, excluding RSS/replay subprocesses. RSS uses `ps` (KiB converted to bytes), heap uses MemoryMXBean, GC uses cumulative GarbageCollectorMXBean counters. MiB=1,048,576 bytes; RSS/heap columns are maxima of the five samples, not allocation totals.
+
+| Slot | Wall s | Process CPU s | RSS MiB | Heap-used MiB | GC count/time ms |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| baseline | 7.389 | 15.736 | 673.30 | 375.74 | 26/153 |
+| profiled | 12.639 | 25.894 | 693.56 | 386.23 | 26/226 |
+| worker-final | 8.622 | 19.002 | 680.11 | 432.74 | 26/179 |
+
+The sole JFR recording (PID61936, recording1) covered12.396450s, produced1,564,509 bytes under the configured32MiB retention cap, and stopped/dumped/closed successfully before all31 replay JVMs. All14 privacy-disabled event types have zero events. Fixed depth8 analysis found142 execution samples,3,598 allocation samples and25 GC events (218.906377ms total duration). Execution samples included main79/Room56/I/O7; JSON/node allocation is visible, but the mixed sample does not isolate a safe production bottleneck. No optimization, GC flag change or additional run was justified. Allocation weights are estimates, not retained live bytes; nonzero post-cleanup RSS/heap is not reported as a leak or a throughput result.
+
+## Exact commands and raw evidence
+
+`evidence/G14-command-ledger.jsonl` records every resolved slot/child argv, PID, exit, profiler lifecycle and budget. The mandatory launcher receipts are in main's `index/evidence/G14/industry-java/load-slots/`. No other main/index write was made.
+
+All large evidence remains ignored under `evidence/runs/g14-initial/`: `frozen-before-baseline.json`, `frozen-source.tar.gz`, the three `*-resolved.json` files and `after-*-source.json` files preserve the source/artifact/command gate. Each `{baseline,profiled,worker-final}/result.json` links to `result-artifacts/live/` streamed inputs/snapshots/states/journals/five measurements and `reference/` results. `final-audit.json` retains the exact counts, bounds and all32 final hashes. `profiled/{capture.jfr,jfr-summary.txt,jfr-events.json,analysis.json}` preserves the single capture and fixed analysis. Build logs and original full/focused/integration XML remain alongside them.
+
+Root-ready default interface: `./track scenario-run <absolute G14.json> <new absolute result.json>`. G14 alone dispatches the installed release-JAR coordinator and owns live1+offline31. Its default JFR is OFF and its default ledger is beside the requested result; G01–G13 routing is unchanged. This command must use the authorized slot launcher; do not run an additional bare load.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""One fixed G14 live JVM, then exactly31 accepted-journal replay JVMs. No retry/warmup."""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+JAVA = Path("/Users/woopinbell/.sdkman/candidates/java/21.0.7-tem/bin/java")
+FIXTURE_SHA = "9e3045a578683cab48abe838a71336b457863811098228462153df7c512b5e6d"
+
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def digest(path):
+    value = hashlib.sha256()
+    with Path(path).open("rb") as source:
+        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(65536), b""):
+            value.update(block)
+    return value.hexdigest()
+
+
+def require(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        raise ValueError(message)
+
+
+def write_json(path, value):
+    with Path(path).open("x") as output:
+        json.dump(value, output, indent=2)
+        output.write("\n")
+
+
+def append(ledger, value):
+    with ledger.open("a") as output:
+        output.write(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
+        output.flush()
+        os.fsync(output.fileno())
+
+
+def resolve(fixture, output, jfr):
+    require(digest(fixture) == FIXTURE_SHA, "frozen G14 fixture bytes required")
+    jar = ROOT / "build/install/arena-java/lib/arena-java.jar"
+    require(jar.is_file() and JAVA.is_file(), "build release artifact with the frozen Java toolchain first")
+    entries = (ROOT / "build/test-runtime-classpath.txt").read_text().strip().split(os.pathsep)
+    excluded = {ROOT / "build/classes/java/main", ROOT / "build/resources/main"}
+    classpath = os.pathsep.join([str(jar)] + [entry for entry in entries if Path(entry) not in excluded])
+    prefix = [str(JAVA), "-Dio.netty.leakDetection.level=paranoid", "-cp", classpath]
+    directory = output.parent / (output.stem + "-artifacts")
+    live = directory / "live/result.json"
+    argv = prefix + ["arena.ReleaseScenario", str(fixture), str(live)]
+    if jfr:
+        argv += ["--jfr", str(jfr)]
+    children = [{"kind": "live", "room_ticks": 19200, "argv": argv,
+                 "result": str(live), "log": str(directory / "live.log")}]
+    for room in range(1, 32):
+        name = f"room-{room:02}"
+        artifact = directory / "live" / (name + ".replay.jsonl")
+        result = directory / "reference" / (name + ".json")
+        children.append({"kind": "offline", "room_id": name, "room_ticks": 600,
+                         "argv": prefix + ["arena.ReplayTool", "replay-verify", str(artifact), str(result)],
+                         "result": str(result), "log": str(directory / "reference" / (name + ".log"))})
+    return {"fixture": str(fixture), "fixture_sha256": FIXTURE_SHA,
+            "installed_jar": str(jar), "installed_jar_sha256": digest(jar), "classpath": classpath,
+            "run_directory": str(directory), "output": str(output), "profiler_attachment": "in-process Recording(profile)" if jfr else "disabled",
+            "jfr": str(jfr) if jfr else None, "children": children}
+
+
+def child(command, ledger, run_id):
+    entry = dict(command, event="child_started", run_id=run_id, cwd=str(ROOT), started_at=now(),
+                 parent_pid=os.getpid(), pid=None, exit_code=None, reaped=False)
+    append(ledger, entry)
+    started = time.monotonic_ns()
+    process = None
+    try:
+        with Path(command["log"]).open("x") as output:
+            process = subprocess.Popen(command["argv"], cwd=ROOT, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+            append(ledger, {"event": "child_pid", "run_id": run_id, "kind": command["kind"],
+                            "result": command["result"], "pid": process.pid})
+            # The outer mandatory load-slot launcher owns the one600s process-group ceiling.
+            code = process.wait()
+        entry.update(event="child_finished", pid=process.pid, exit_code=code, reaped=True)
+    except BaseException as failure:
+        entry.update(event="child_failed", error=f"{type(failure).__name__}: {failure}")
+        if process is not None:
+            if process.poll() is None:
+                process.kill()
+            try:
+                process.wait(timeout=5)
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                pass
+            entry.update(pid=process.pid, exit_code=process.returncode, reaped=process.returncode is not None)
+        raise
+    finally:
+        entry.update(ended_at=now(), wall_ns=time.monotonic_ns() - started)
+        if Path(command["log"]).exists():
+            entry["log_sha256"] = digest(command["log"])
+        if Path(command["result"]).exists():
+            try:
+                observed = json.loads(Path(command["result"]).read_text())
+                entry.update(actual_room_ticks=observed.get("executed_ticks"), result_sha256=digest(command["result"]),
+                             passed=observed.get("passed"))
+            except (OSError, ValueError) as failure:
+                entry["result_observation_error"] = f"{type(failure).__name__}: {failure}"
+        append(ledger, entry)
+    require(code == 0, f"{command['kind']} child exit{code}; stopped without retry")
+
+
+def run(description, ledger):
+    directory = Path(description["run_directory"])
+    output = Path(description["output"])
+    require(not output.exists(), "requested result already exists")
+    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    (directory / "live").mkdir()
+    (directory / "reference").mkdir()
+    write_json(directory / "resolved-commands.json", description)
+    run_id = str(directory)
+    result = {"thread": "G14", "fixture_sha256": FIXTURE_SHA, "started_at": now(), "pid": os.getpid(),
+              "scope": "live measured JVM followed by31 separate reference JVMs; no warmup or retry",
+              "warm_runs": 0, "live_room_ticks": None, "reference_room_ticks": 0, "reference_pairs": 0,
+              "passed": False, "references": []}
+    if ledger is None:
+        ledger = directory / "commands.jsonl"
+        with ledger.open("x") as reservation:
+            reservation.write(json.dumps({"event": "root_default_ledger", "created_at": now(), "fixture_sha256": FIXTURE_SHA}) + "\n")
+    result["command_ledger"] = str(ledger)
+    append(ledger, {"event": "release_wrapper_started", "run_id": run_id, "pid": os.getpid(),
+                    "argv": [sys.executable, *sys.argv], "started_at": result["started_at"]})
+    try:
+        live_command = description["children"][0]
+        try:
+            child(live_command, ledger, run_id)
+        finally:
+            sample_path = directory / "live/measurements.jsonl"
+            if sample_path.exists():
+                for line in sample_path.read_text().splitlines():
+                    sample = json.loads(line)
+                    append(ledger, {"event": "rss_child_observed", "run_id": run_id,
+                                    "phase": sample["phase"], "executed_ticks": sample["executed_ticks"], **sample["rss"]})
+            if Path(live_command["result"]).exists():
+                live = json.loads(Path(live_command["result"]).read_text())
+                result["live_room_ticks"] = live["executed_ticks"]
+                append(ledger, {"event": "profiler_lifecycle", "run_id": run_id, **live["profiler"]})
+        live = json.loads(Path(live_command["result"]).read_text())
+        require(live["passed"] and live["executed_ticks"] == 19200 and live["captured_ticks"] == 19200,
+                "live fixed scenario did not complete")
+        profiler = live["profiler"]
+        require(profiler["closed"] and not profiler["active"] and profiler["status"] != "FAILED",
+                "profile interval/ownership not closed before references")
+        result["live_result"] = {"path": live_command["result"], "sha256": digest(live_command["result"])}
+        pairs_path = directory / "reference-pairs.jsonl"
+        with pairs_path.open("x") as pairs:
+            for command in description["children"][1:]:
+                try:
+                    child(command, ledger, run_id)
+                finally:
+                    if Path(command["result"]).exists():
+                        recorded = json.loads(Path(command["result"]).read_text())
+                        result["reference_room_ticks"] += recorded.get("executed_ticks", 0)
+                reference = json.loads(Path(command["result"]).read_text())
+                require(reference["passed"] and reference["all_resources_released"] and reference["executed_ticks"] == 600
+                        and len(reference["accepted_inputs"]) == 2400, "reference actual accepted-journal count/cleanup")
+                require(len(reference["canonical_records"]) == len(reference["state_hashes"]) == 600, "reference record count")
+                count = 0
+                with (directory / "live" / (command["room_id"] + ".ticks.jsonl")).open() as states:
+                    for tick, line in enumerate(states):
+                        observed = json.loads(line)
+                        require(tick < 600 and observed["tick"] == tick
+                                and observed["state_hash"] == reference["state_hashes"][tick]
+                                and observed["canonical_record"] == reference["canonical_records"][tick], "live/reference exact canonical divergence")
+                        pairs.write(json.dumps({"room_id": command["room_id"], "tick": tick,
+                                                "live_hash": observed["state_hash"], "reference_hash": reference["state_hashes"][tick]},
+                                               separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
+                        count += 1
+                require(count == 600, "live tick row count")
+                pairs.flush()
+                result["reference_pairs"] += count
+                result["references"].append({"room_id": command["room_id"], "path": command["result"],
+                                             "sha256": digest(command["result"]), "executed_ticks": reference["executed_ticks"],
+                                             "final_hash": reference["state_hashes"][-1]})
+        require(result["reference_room_ticks"] == result["reference_pairs"] == 18600, "exact31x600 reference allowance")
+        result["pairs"] = {"path": str(pairs_path), "sha256": digest(pairs_path), "bytes": pairs_path.stat().st_size}
+        result["passed"] = True
+    except BaseException as failure:
+        result["error"] = f"{type(failure).__name__}: {failure}"
+    finally:
+        result["finished_at"] = now()
+        write_json(output, result)
+        append(ledger, {"event": "release_wrapper_finished", "run_id": run_id, "pid": os.getpid(),
+                        "finished_at": result["finished_at"], "passed": result["passed"],
+                        "actual_live_ticks": result["live_room_ticks"], "actual_reference_ticks": result["reference_room_ticks"],
+                        "result": str(output), "result_sha256": digest(output)})
+    print(json.dumps({key: result[key] for key in ("passed", "live_room_ticks", "reference_room_ticks", "reference_pairs")}), flush=True)
+    return 0 if result["passed"] else 1
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("fixture", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--ledger", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--jfr", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--describe", action="store_true", help="resolve source/argv only; never launch an application")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    fixture, output = args.fixture.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
+    ledger = args.ledger.resolve() if args.ledger else None
+    description = resolve(fixture, output, args.jfr.resolve() if args.jfr else None)
+    if args.describe:
+        print(json.dumps(description, indent=2))
+        return 0
+    require(ledger is None or ledger.exists(), "create/freeze the explicit execution ledger before a worker load")
+    return run(description, ledger)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/src/test/java/arena/ReleaseHarnessTest.java b/src/test/java/arena/ReleaseHarnessTest.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1f3d83b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/test/java/arena/ReleaseHarnessTest.java
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+package arena;
+
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
+import io.netty.channel.embedded.EmbeddedChannel;
+import io.netty.channel.socket.DatagramPacket;
+import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+
+/** One zero-server/zero-tick prerequisite check; never invokes the G14 load. */
+final class ReleaseHarnessTest {
+    @Test void snapshotReadinessHoldDoesNotReleaseSnapshotsWithOrderedInputAcks() throws Exception {
+        EmbeddedChannel tcp = new EmbeddedChannel(), udp = new EmbeddedChannel();
+        OutboundQueue.Metrics metrics = new OutboundQueue.Metrics();
+        OutboundQueue queue = new OutboundQueue(tcp, () -> udp, metrics, new UdpData.Metrics());
+        InetSocketAddress endpoint = new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 9);
+        SnapshotReadiness hold = new SnapshotReadiness(queue);
+        try {
+            queue.realtime(Json.message("SNAPSHOT").put("kind", "FULL").put("snapshot_seq", 2), endpoint);
+            ObjectNode first = hold.sample(true); assertEquals(1, first.path("pending_full").asInt()); assertNull(udp.readOutbound());
+            assertEquals(2, first.path("queued_snapshot_wires").path("full").path("wire").path("snapshot_seq").asInt());
+            assertEquals(1, first.path("queued_snapshot_wires").path("full").path("ref_count").asInt());
+            queue.realtime(Json.message("INPUT_ACK").put("status", "ACCEPTED").put("seq", 1), endpoint);
+            DatagramPacket acknowledgement = udp.readOutbound(); assertNotNull(acknowledgement);
+            try {
+                byte[] bytes = new byte[acknowledgement.content().readableBytes()]; acknowledgement.content().getBytes(acknowledgement.content().readerIndex(), bytes);
+                assertEquals("INPUT_ACK", Json.read(bytes).path("type").asText());
+            } finally { acknowledgement.release(); }
+            tcp.runPendingTasks(); udp.runPendingTasks();
+            assertNull(udp.readOutbound()); assertEquals(1, queue.view().path("pending_full").asInt());
+            queue.realtime(Json.message("SNAPSHOT").put("kind", "FULL").put("snapshot_seq", 3), endpoint);
+            ObjectNode held = hold.sample(); assertEquals(1, held.path("superseded_releases").asInt());
+            assertEquals(1, held.path("observed_released_snapshot_buffers").asInt()); assertEquals(0, held.path("sent_snapshots").asInt());
+            assertTrue(held.path("ordered_actual_readiness_checks").asLong() > 0);
+        } finally {
+            queue.close(); tcp.finishAndReleaseAll(); udp.finishAndReleaseAll();
+            assertEquals(0, hold.sample().path("observed_live_snapshot_buffers").asInt());
+            assertEquals(0, metrics.retainedBytes.get()); assertEquals(0, metrics.transportBuffers.get());
+        }
+    }
+}
diff --git a/src/test/java/arena/ReleaseMetrics.java b/src/test/java/arena/ReleaseMetrics.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6943be4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/test/java/arena/ReleaseMetrics.java
@@ -0,0 +1,308 @@
+package arena;
+
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ArrayNode;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
+import java.io.Closeable;
+import java.io.IOException;
+import java.io.InputStream;
+import java.lang.management.BufferPoolMXBean;
+import java.lang.management.GarbageCollectorMXBean;
+import java.lang.management.ManagementFactory;
+import java.lang.management.MemoryUsage;
+import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
+import java.nio.file.Files;
+import java.nio.file.Path;
+import java.security.MessageDigest;
+import java.time.Duration;
+import java.time.Instant;
+import java.util.HexFormat;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.TreeMap;
+import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
+import jdk.jfr.Configuration;
+import jdk.jfr.Recording;
+import jdk.jfr.RecordingState;
+
+/** Test-runtime observations only; the caller controls every sample and the sole JFR interval. */
+final class ReleaseMetrics {
+    private static final long PROFILE_MAX_BYTES = 32L * 1024 * 1024;
+    private static final int PS_OUTPUT_LIMIT = 4096;
+    private static final Path PROFILE_JFC = Path.of(
+            "/Users/woopinbell/.sdkman/candidates/java/21.0.7-tem/lib/jfr/profile.jfc");
+    private static final String PROFILE_JFC_SHA256 =
+            "485fb90dbecee9a950c45247464351162b1eb0c35387fbb929f002c600807251";
+    private static final List<String> PRIVATE_EVENTS = List.of(
+            "jdk.InitialEnvironmentVariable", "jdk.InitialSystemProperty", "jdk.JVMInformation",
+            "jdk.SystemProcess", "jdk.ProcessStart", "jdk.StringFlag", "jdk.StringFlagChanged",
+            "jdk.InitialSecurityProperty", "jdk.SecurityPropertyModification", "jdk.JavaAgent",
+            "jdk.NativeAgent", "jdk.JavaExceptionThrow", "jdk.JavaErrorThrow", "jdk.OldObjectSample");
+
+    private final ProcessHandle process = ProcessHandle.current();
+    private final long startedNanos = System.nanoTime();
+    private final String startedAt = Instant.now().toString();
+    private final Long initialCpuNanos = cpuNanos();
+    private final Path profilePath;
+    private final ObjectNode profile = Json.MAPPER.createObjectNode();
+    private Recording recording;
+    private boolean startCalled;
+    private boolean finished;
+
+    ReleaseMetrics(Path optionalJfr) {
+        profilePath = optionalJfr == null ? null : optionalJfr.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
+        profile.put("enabled", profilePath != null).put("capture_attempted", false)
+                .put("pid", process.pid()).put("attachment", "in_process")
+                .put("configuration", "profile").put("max_size_bytes", PROFILE_MAX_BYTES)
+                .put("disk", true).put("active", false).put("closed", true)
+                .put("status", profilePath == null ? "DISABLED" : "NOT_STARTED")
+                .put("profile_jfc_path", PROFILE_JFC.toString())
+                .put("profile_jfc_expected_sha256", PROFILE_JFC_SHA256);
+        if (profilePath == null) profile.putNull("path");
+        else profile.put("path", profilePath.toString());
+        ObjectNode overrides = profile.putObject("privacy_settings_overrides");
+        PRIVATE_EVENTS.forEach(name -> overrides.put(name + "#enabled", "false"));
+        profile.putArray("errors");
+    }
+
+    /** Call once after initialization, also on unprofiled runs; unavailable JFR remains explicit. */
+    ObjectNode startProfile() {
+        if (startCalled || finished) throw new IllegalStateException("profile start is one-shot");
+        startCalled = true;
+        profile.put("start_called_at", Instant.now().toString());
+        if (profilePath == null) return profile.deepCopy();
+        profile.put("capture_attempted", true).put("status", "STARTING");
+        try {
+            String fileHash = sha256(Files.readAllBytes(PROFILE_JFC));
+            Configuration configuration = Configuration.getConfiguration("profile");
+            String configurationHash = sha256(configuration.getContents().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
+            profile.put("profile_jfc_sha256", fileHash)
+                    .put("configuration_contents_sha256", configurationHash);
+            if (!PROFILE_JFC_SHA256.equals(fileHash) || !fileHash.equals(configurationHash))
+                throw new IOException("profile configuration differs from the statically inspected file");
+            if (Files.exists(profilePath)) throw new IOException("JFR artifact already exists");
+            Files.createDirectories(profilePath.getParent());
+            TreeMap<String, String> settings = new TreeMap<>(configuration.getSettings());
+            PRIVATE_EVENTS.forEach(name -> settings.put(name + "#enabled", "false"));
+            recording = new Recording(configuration);
+            profile.put("recording_id", recording.getId()).put("closed", false);
+            recording.setName("G14 release");
+            recording.setSettings(settings);
+            recording.setToDisk(true);
+            recording.setMaxSize(PROFILE_MAX_BYTES);
+            recording.setDumpOnExit(false);
+            ObjectNode effective = profile.putObject("effective_settings");
+            new TreeMap<>(recording.getSettings()).forEach(effective::put);
+            profile.put("disk", recording.isToDisk()).put("max_size_bytes", recording.getMaxSize());
+            recording.start();
+            profile.put("start_time", recording.getStartTime().toString())
+                    .put("start_returned_monotonic_ns", System.nanoTime())
+                    .put("active", true).put("status", "RUNNING");
+        } catch (Exception | LinkageError failure) {
+            error(profile, "start", failure);
+            profile.put("status", "UNAVAILABLE");
+            closeRecording();
+        }
+        return profile.deepCopy();
+    }
+
+    /** Cumulative JVM counters and one bounded, separately identified RSS subprocess. */
+    ObjectNode sample(String phase, int executedTicks) throws Exception {
+        long sampledAt = System.nanoTime();
+        ObjectNode result = Json.MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("phase", phase)
+                .put("executed_ticks", executedTicks).put("pid", process.pid())
+                .put("timestamp_utc", Instant.now().toString()).put("sampler_started_at", startedAt)
+                .put("wall_elapsed_ns", sampledAt - startedNanos)
+                .put("wall_source", "System.nanoTime");
+        Long cpu = cpuNanos();
+        ObjectNode cpuView = result.putObject("process_cpu")
+                .put("source", "ProcessHandle.current().info().totalCpuDuration")
+                .put("scope", "live JVM including harness; excludes ps and reference child processes")
+                .put("available", cpu != null);
+        if (cpu == null) cpuView.putNull("total_ns");
+        else cpuView.put("total_ns", cpu);
+        if (cpu == null || initialCpuNanos == null) cpuView.putNull("elapsed_since_sampler_start_ns");
+        else cpuView.put("elapsed_since_sampler_start_ns", cpu - initialCpuNanos);
+        MemoryUsage heap = ManagementFactory.getMemoryMXBean().getHeapMemoryUsage();
+        ObjectNode heapView = result.putObject("heap").put("source", "MemoryMXBean.getHeapMemoryUsage");
+        counter(heapView, "used_bytes", heap.getUsed());
+        counter(heapView, "committed_bytes", heap.getCommitted());
+        counter(heapView, "max_bytes", heap.getMax());
+        ArrayNode collectors = result.putArray("garbage_collectors");
+        for (GarbageCollectorMXBean collector : ManagementFactory.getGarbageCollectorMXBeans()) {
+            ObjectNode value = collectors.addObject().put("name", collector.getName())
+                    .put("source", "GarbageCollectorMXBean; cumulative since JVM start")
+                    .put("valid", collector.isValid());
+            counter(value, "collection_count", collector.getCollectionCount());
+            counter(value, "collection_time_ms", collector.getCollectionTime());
+        }
+        ArrayNode pools = result.putArray("buffer_pools");
+        for (BufferPoolMXBean pool : ManagementFactory.getPlatformMXBeans(BufferPoolMXBean.class)) {
+            if (!pool.getName().equals("direct") && !pool.getName().startsWith("mapped")) continue;
+            ObjectNode value = pools.addObject().put("name", pool.getName()).put("source", "BufferPoolMXBean");
+            counter(value, "count", pool.getCount());
+            counter(value, "memory_used_bytes", pool.getMemoryUsed());
+            counter(value, "total_capacity_bytes", pool.getTotalCapacity());
+        }
+        result.set("rss", rss());
+        result.put("profile_status", profile.path("status").asText())
+                .put("sample_duration_ns", System.nanoTime() - sampledAt);
+        return result;
+    }
+
+    /** Stop, dump once to a newly reserved artifact, and close; never mask a caller's failure. */
+    ObjectNode finish() {
+        if (finished) return profile.deepCopy();
+        finished = true;
+        profile.put("finish_called_at", Instant.now().toString());
+        try {
+            if (recording != null && recording.getState() == RecordingState.RUNNING) {
+                profile.put("stop_called_at", Instant.now().toString());
+                try {
+                    recording.stop();
+                    profile.put("stop_time", recording.getStopTime().toString())
+                            .put("stop_returned_monotonic_ns", System.nanoTime()).put("active", false);
+                } catch (Exception | LinkageError failure) { error(profile, "stop", failure); }
+                profile.put("dump_called_at", Instant.now().toString());
+                try {
+                    Files.createFile(profilePath);
+                    profile.put("artifact_reserved_create_new", true);
+                    recording.dump(profilePath);
+                    profile.put("dump_completed_at", Instant.now().toString())
+                            .put("artifact_bytes", Files.size(profilePath));
+                } catch (Exception | LinkageError failure) { error(profile, "dump", failure); }
+            }
+        } catch (Exception | LinkageError failure) {
+            error(profile, "finish", failure);
+        } finally {
+            closeRecording();
+            boolean failedCleanup = false;
+            for (var failure : profile.withArray("errors"))
+                if (List.of("stop", "dump", "close", "finish").contains(failure.path("stage").asText())) failedCleanup = true;
+            if (failedCleanup) profile.put("status", "FAILED");
+            else if (profile.path("capture_attempted").asBoolean()
+                    && !profile.path("status").asText().equals("UNAVAILABLE"))
+                profile.put("status", profile.withArray("errors").isEmpty() ? "COMPLETE" : "FAILED");
+            profile.put("finish_completed_at", Instant.now().toString());
+        }
+        return profile.deepCopy();
+    }
+
+    private void closeRecording() {
+        if (recording == null) return;
+        profile.put("close_called_at", Instant.now().toString());
+        try {
+            recording.close();
+            profile.put("closed", true).put("active", false)
+                    .put("final_recording_state", recording.getState().toString())
+                    .put("close_completed_at", Instant.now().toString());
+            recording = null;
+        } catch (Exception | LinkageError failure) { error(profile, "close", failure); }
+    }
+
+    private Long cpuNanos() {
+        return process.info().totalCpuDuration().map(Duration::toNanos).orElse(null);
+    }
+
+    private ObjectNode rss() {
+        long started = System.nanoTime();
+        List<String> argv = List.of("/bin/ps", "-o", "rss=", "-p", Long.toString(process.pid()));
+        ObjectNode result = Json.MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("source", "/bin/ps RSS in KiB")
+                .put("observed_pid", process.pid()).put("started_at", Instant.now().toString())
+                .put("timeout_seconds", 5).put("kill_reap_timeout_seconds", 5)
+                .put("available", false).put("timed_out", false).put("status", "UNAVAILABLE");
+        result.putNull("child_pid").putNull("exit_code").putNull("stdout").putNull("stderr");
+        ArrayNode arguments = result.putArray("argv");
+        argv.forEach(arguments::add);
+        result.putArray("errors");
+        Process child = null;
+        boolean interrupted = false;
+        try {
+            child = new ProcessBuilder(argv).start();
+            result.put("child_pid", child.pid());
+            if (!child.waitFor(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) result.put("timed_out", true);
+        } catch (InterruptedException failure) {
+            interrupted = true;
+            error(result, "wait", failure);
+            result.put("status", "INTERRUPTED");
+        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure) { error(result, "start_or_wait", failure); }
+        finally {
+            if (child != null) {
+                if (child.isAlive()) reap(child, result);
+                result.put("reaped", !child.isAlive());
+                if (!child.isAlive()) {
+                    result.put("exit_code", child.exitValue());
+                    try {
+                        output(result, "stdout", child.getInputStream());
+                        output(result, "stderr", child.getErrorStream());
+                    } catch (IOException failure) { error(result, "read_output", failure); }
+                } else result.putNull("exit_code");
+                closeStream(child.getInputStream(), result);
+                closeStream(child.getErrorStream(), result);
+                closeStream(child.getOutputStream(), result);
+            } else {
+                result.putNull("child_pid").putNull("exit_code").put("reaped", true);
+            }
+            result.put("ended_at", Instant.now().toString()).put("wall_elapsed_ns", System.nanoTime() - started);
+            if (interrupted) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
+        }
+        if (result.path("timed_out").asBoolean()) result.put("status", "TIMED_OUT");
+        if (!result.path("reaped").asBoolean()) result.put("status", "NOT_REAPED");
+        if (child != null && result.path("reaped").asBoolean() && !result.path("timed_out").asBoolean()
+                && result.path("exit_code").asInt(-1) == 0 && result.withArray("errors").isEmpty()) {
+            try {
+                String value = result.path("stdout").asText().trim();
+                if (result.path("stdout_truncated").asBoolean() || !value.matches("[0-9]+"))
+                    throw new IOException("ps did not return one nonnegative RSS integer");
+                long kib = Long.parseLong(value);
+                result.put("rss_kib", kib).put("rss_bytes", Math.multiplyExact(kib, 1024L))
+                        .put("available", true).put("status", "OBSERVED");
+            } catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure) { error(result, "parse_rss", failure); }
+        }
+        if (!result.path("available").asBoolean()) result.putNull("rss_kib").putNull("rss_bytes");
+        return result;
+    }
+
+    private static void reap(Process child, ObjectNode result) {
+        result.put("kill_requested", true);
+        boolean interrupted = false;
+        try {
+            child.destroyForcibly();
+            long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5);
+            while (child.isAlive()) {
+                long remaining = deadline - System.nanoTime();
+                if (remaining <= 0) break;
+                try { child.waitFor(remaining, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS); }
+                catch (InterruptedException failure) {
+                    interrupted = true;
+                    error(result, "kill_reap_wait", failure);
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (RuntimeException failure) { error(result, "kill_reap", failure); }
+        finally { if (interrupted) Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
+    }
+
+    private static void output(ObjectNode result, String name, InputStream stream) throws IOException {
+        byte[] bytes = stream.readNBytes(PS_OUTPUT_LIMIT + 1);
+        result.put(name, new String(bytes, 0, Math.min(bytes.length, PS_OUTPUT_LIMIT), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
+                .put(name + "_truncated", bytes.length > PS_OUTPUT_LIMIT);
+    }
+
+    private static void closeStream(Closeable stream, ObjectNode result) {
+        try { stream.close(); }
+        catch (IOException failure) { error(result, "close_ps_stream", failure); }
+    }
+
+    private static void counter(ObjectNode result, String name, long value) {
+        result.put(name + "_available", value >= 0);
+        if (value < 0) result.putNull(name);
+        else result.put(name, value);
+    }
+
+    private static String sha256(byte[] bytes) throws Exception {
+        return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes));
+    }
+
+    private static void error(ObjectNode result, String stage, Throwable failure) {
+        result.withArray("errors").addObject().put("stage", stage)
+                .put("type", failure.getClass().getName()).put("message", failure.getMessage());
+    }
+}
diff --git a/src/test/java/arena/ReleaseScenario.java b/src/test/java/arena/ReleaseScenario.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..785eca7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/test/java/arena/ReleaseScenario.java
@@ -0,0 +1,450 @@
+package arena;
+
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ArrayNode;
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
+import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
+import io.netty.channel.Channel;
+import io.netty.channel.ChannelHandlerContext;
+import io.netty.channel.ChannelOutboundHandlerAdapter;
+import io.netty.channel.ChannelPromise;
+import io.netty.channel.nio.NioEventLoopGroup;
+import io.netty.channel.socket.DatagramPacket;
+import java.io.BufferedWriter;
+import java.io.IOException;
+import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
+import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
+import java.nio.channels.DatagramChannel;
+import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
+import java.nio.file.Files;
+import java.nio.file.Path;
+import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
+import java.security.MessageDigest;
+import java.time.Instant;
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.Deque;
+import java.util.HexFormat;
+import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.Map;
+import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
+import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
+
+/** Test-runtime release load. Raw observations are streamed; no offline Room tick runs in this JVM. */
+public final class ReleaseScenario {
+    static final String SHA256 = "9e3045a578683cab48abe838a71336b457863811098228462153df7c512b5e6d";
+    private ReleaseScenario() { }
+
+    private static final class Client {
+        final String id; final int slot; final TcpClient socket; final AckScenario.Replica replica = new AckScenario.Replica();
+        OutboundQueue queue; Object stream; int inputAcks, snapshots, snapshotAcks; String direction = "STOP";
+        Client(String id, int slot, TcpClient socket) { this.id = id; this.slot = slot; this.socket = socket; }
+    }
+    private static final class LiveRoom {
+        final ObjectNode fixture, result; final List<Client> clients = new ArrayList<>();
+        final Map<String, TcpClient> bindings = new LinkedHashMap<>();
+        RoomRuntime runtime; ObjectNode state; String record, hash; Lines ticks;
+        LiveRoom(ObjectNode fixture, ObjectNode result) { this.fixture = fixture; this.result = result; result.put("room_id", id()); }
+        String id() { return fixture.path("room_id").asText(); }
+    }
+
+    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
+        if (args.length != 2 && !(args.length == 4 && args[2].equals("--jfr")))
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException("ReleaseScenario <fixed G14> <new result.json> [--jfr <new artifact>]");
+        Path input = Path.of(args[0]), output = Path.of(args[1]);
+        ObjectNode result = run(input, output, args.length == 4 ? Path.of(args[3]) : null);
+        Files.write(output, Json.MAPPER.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValueAsBytes(result), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
+        System.out.println("G14 live " + (result.path("passed").asBoolean() ? "PASS" : "FAIL") + " actual Room ticks=" + result.path("executed_ticks").asInt());
+        if (!result.path("passed").asBoolean()) System.exit(1);
+    }
+
+    private static ObjectNode run(Path input, Path output, Path jfr) throws Exception {
+        byte[] scenarioBytes = Files.readAllBytes(input);
+        if (!SHA256.equals(UdpScenario.hash(scenarioBytes))) throw new IOException("frozen G14 bytes required");
+        ObjectNode fixture = Json.read(scenarioBytes), result = Json.MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("thread", "G14").put("profile", "realtime-core")
+                .put("scenario_sha256", SHA256).put("process_id", ProcessHandle.current().pid()).put("started_at", Instant.now().toString())
+                .put("server_instances", 1).put("warm_runs", 0).put("offline_ticks_in_live_process", 0)
+                .put("runtime_version", Runtime.version().toString()).put("measurements_scope", "one release JVM: server plus fixed streaming harness; excludes31 later replay JVMs")
+                .put("buffer_probe_scope", "constant counters for original writes; at most300 Java wrappers observe slow original buffers without retain")
+                .put("production_class_source", Room.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toString());
+        Path directory = output.toAbsolutePath().getParent(); Files.createDirectories(directory);
+        ArrayNode failures = result.putArray("failures"); List<LiveRoom> rooms = new ArrayList<>(); List<Lines> streams = new ArrayList<>();
+        AtomicLong now = new AtomicLong(); ArenaServer server = null; SnapshotReadiness slowHold = null; BufferProbe buffers = null;
+        ReleaseMetrics measurements = new ReleaseMetrics(jfr); Lines inputs = null, snapshots = null, samples = null, progress = null;
+        int lcg = fixture.path("seed").asInt(), inputAttempts = 0, inputAcks = 0;
+        try {

+    private static Lines lines(List<Lines> streams, Path path) throws IOException {
+        Lines result = new Lines(path); streams.add(result); return result;
+    }
+    private static final class Lines implements AutoCloseable {
+        final Path path; final BufferedWriter writer; long rows; boolean closed;
+        Lines(Path path) throws IOException {
+            this.path = path; writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
+        }
+        void add(JsonNode value) throws IOException { writer.write(Json.MAPPER.writeValueAsString(value)); writer.write('\n'); rows++; }
+        void flush() throws IOException { writer.flush(); }
+        @Override public void close() throws IOException { if (!closed) { writer.close(); closed = true; } }
+        ObjectNode manifest() throws Exception {
+            MessageDigest digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256"); byte[] buffer = new byte[65_536];
+            try (var source = Files.newInputStream(path)) { int count; while ((count = source.read(buffer)) != -1) digest.update(buffer, 0, count); }
+            return Json.MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("path", path.toString()).put("rows", rows).put("closed", closed)
+                    .put("bytes", Files.size(path)).put("sha256", HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest.digest()));
+        }
+    }

+    private static void bindQueues(ArenaServer server, List<LiveRoom> rooms) throws Exception {
+        ReplayFixture.owned(server, () -> {
+            Map<String, Client> clients = new LinkedHashMap<>();
+            for (LiveRoom room : rooms) for (Client client : room.clients) clients.put(client.socket.sessionId, client);
+            int matched = 0;
+            for (var session : ((Map<?, ?>) ReplayFixture.field(server, "sessions")).entrySet()) {
+                Client client = clients.get(ReplayFixture.field(session.getValue(), "id"));
+                if (client == null) throw new IOException("unmapped real session");
+                client.queue = (OutboundQueue) ReplayFixture.field(session.getKey(), "outbound");
+                client.stream = ReplayFixture.field(session.getValue(), "snapshots"); matched++;
+            }
+            require(matched == 128 && clients.size() == 128, "all actual peer/session mappings"); return null;
+        });
+    }

+    /** Reads the actual owner state once; never performs a second simulation. */
+    private static int observeRooms(ArenaServer server, List<LiveRoom> rooms, int tick, boolean record) throws Exception {
+        int actualTicks = ReplayFixture.owned(server, () -> {
+            int actual = 0;
+            for (LiveRoom room : rooms) {
+                Room model = room.runtime.room; room.state = ReplayFixture.view(model); room.record = model.canonicalRecord();
+                room.hash = ReplayLog.hash(room.record); actual += model.executedTicks();
+                require(model.executedTicks() == tick + 1 && room.state.path("tick").asInt() == tick
+                        && room.state.path("status").asText().equals("RUNNING") && room.state.withArray("players").size() == 4,
+                        "actual independent Room clock/roster " + room.id());
+                for (Client client : room.clients) {
+                    JsonNode player = ReplayScenario.player(room.state, client.id);
+                    require(player.path("slot").asInt() == client.slot && player.path("connectivity").asText().equals("CONNECTED")
+                            && player.path("last_accepted_seq").asInt() == tick + 1 && player.path("pending_inputs").asInt() == 0
+                            && player.path("direction").asText().equals(client.direction) && player.path("score").asInt() == 0
+                            && player.path("x").asInt() >= 0 && player.path("x").asInt() <= 100_000
+                            && player.path("y").asInt() >= 0 && player.path("y").asInt() <= 100_000, "actual fixed input effect " + client.id + "/" + tick);
+                }
+                if (record) {
+                    require(room.hash.equals(model.stateHash()), "actual canonical/hash equality");
+                } else room.result.put("initial_canonical_record", room.record).put("initial_state_hash", room.hash);
+            }
+            return actual;
+        });
+        if (record) for (LiveRoom room : rooms) {
+            ObjectNode row = Json.MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("room_id", room.id()).put("tick", tick)
+                    .put("canonical_record", room.record).put("state_hash", room.hash);
+            row.set("state", room.state); room.ticks.add(row);
+        }
+        return actualTicks;
+    }

+    private static void captureSnapshots(ArenaServer server, List<LiveRoom> rooms, Lines output, int sequence, boolean held) throws Exception {
+        awaitTransport(server, rooms, held); int received = ReplayFixture.udpReceived(server), acknowledgements = 0;
+        List<ObjectNode> batch = new ArrayList<>(128); List<Client> recipients = new ArrayList<>(128);
+        try {
+        for (LiveRoom room : rooms) for (Client client : room.clients) {
+            if (held && room == rooms.getFirst() && client.slot == 0) continue;
+            ObjectNode wire = client.socket.until("SNAPSHOT"); String application = client.replica.apply(wire);
+            ObjectNode cell = Json.MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("room_id", room.id()).put("player_id", client.id)
+                    .put("actual_received", true).put("bytes", Json.bytes(wire).length).put("application", application);
+            cell.set("wire", wire); batch.add(cell); recipients.add(client); client.snapshots++;
+            require(application.equals("APPLIED") && wire.path("snapshot_seq").asInt() == sequence
+                    && wire.path("room_id").asText().equals(room.id()) && wire.path("tick").asInt() == room.state.path("tick").asInt()
+                    && wire.path("state_hash").asText().equals(room.hash) && client.replica.state.equals(SnapshotScenario.projection(room.state))
+                    && Json.bytes(wire).length <= 1_200, "actual snapshot/replica/hash " + client.id + "/" + sequence);
+            ObjectNode ack = client.socket.auth("SNAPSHOT_ACK", room.id()).put("snapshot_seq", sequence).put("state_hash", room.hash);
+            cell.set("actual_ack", aliased(ack, client.id)); client.socket.send(ack); client.snapshotAcks++; acknowledgements++;
+        }
+        ReplayFixture.udpBarrier(server, received + acknowledgements);
+        ReplayFixture.owned(server, () -> {
+            for (int index = 0; index < recipients.size(); index++) {
+                ObjectNode stream = AckScenario.stream(recipients.get(index).stream);
+                batch.get(index).put("server_ack_watermark_after_batch", stream.path("acknowledged_seq").asLong());
+                require(stream.path("acknowledged_seq").asInt() == sequence && stream.path("retained_count").asInt() <= 32,
+                        "only actual received/applied snapshot ACK admitted");
+            }
+            return null;
+        });
+        } finally { for (ObjectNode cell : batch) output.add(cell); output.flush(); }
+    }

+    private static void awaitTransport(ArenaServer server, List<LiveRoom> rooms, boolean held) throws Exception {
+        NioEventLoopGroup io = (NioEventLoopGroup) ReplayFixture.field(server, "ioLoop"); long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5);
+        while (true) {
+            io.submit(() -> { }).get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS); boolean idle = true;
+            for (LiveRoom room : rooms) for (Client client : room.clients) {
+                ObjectNode view = client.queue.view(); require(withinBounds(view), "queued plus transport ownership bound");
+                boolean slow = held && room == rooms.getFirst() && client.slot == 0;
+                if (view.path("pending_ordered").asInt() != 0 || view.path("transport_pending_buffers").asInt() != 0
+                        || view.path("flush_task_pending").asBoolean() || !slow && view.path("retained_bytes").asInt() != 0) idle = false;
+            }
+            if (idle) return;
+            if (System.nanoTime() >= deadline) throw new IOException("actual nonblocking transport completion barrier ceiling");
+        }
+    }

+    private static boolean withinBounds(ObjectNode queue) {
+        return queue.path("pending_ordered").asInt() <= 64 && queue.path("pending_control").asInt() <= 64
+                && queue.path("pending_full").asInt() <= 1 && queue.path("pending_delta").asInt() <= 1
+                && queue.path("transport_pending_buffers").asInt() <= 1;
+    }

+    private static void sample(ReleaseMetrics measurements, Lines samples, String phase, int expectedBoundary, ArenaServer server,
+                               List<LiveRoom> rooms, SnapshotReadiness hold, long manualNanos, int inputAcks) throws Exception {
+        ObjectNode runtime = server.metrics(), actual = Json.MAPPER.createObjectNode(); int total = 0, common = -1; boolean same = true;
+        String source = "unknown";
+        if (runtime.has("rooms")) {
+            source = "actual live owner snapshot";
+            for (JsonNode room : runtime.withArray("rooms")) actual.put(room.path("room_id").asText(), room.path("executed_ticks").asInt());
+        } else if (runtime.path("owner_terminated").asBoolean()) {
+            source = "owner termination verified before reading immutable executedTicks scalars";
+            for (LiveRoom room : rooms) if (room.runtime != null) actual.put(room.id(), (int) ReplayFixture.field(room.runtime.room, "executedTicks"));
+        }
+        for (JsonNode ticks : actual) { total += ticks.asInt(); if (common == -1) common = ticks.asInt(); else if (common != ticks.asInt()) same = false; }
+        boolean complete = actual.size() == rooms.size() && !rooms.isEmpty();
+        ObjectNode value = measurements.sample(phase, complete && same ? common : -1);
+        if (!complete || !same) value.putNull("executed_ticks");
+        value.set("actual_room_executed_ticks", actual); value.put("actual_tick_observation_source", source);
+        if (complete) value.put("actual_total_room_ticks", total); else value.putNull("actual_total_room_ticks");
+        if (expectedBoundary >= 0) value.put("expected_boundary_ticks", expectedBoundary); else value.putNull("expected_boundary_ticks");
+        value.put("manual_time_ns", manualNanos).put("actual_input_acks", inputAcks); value.set("server", runtime);
+        if (hold != null) value.set("slow_snapshot_queue", hold.sample(true));
+        samples.add(value); samples.flush();
+        require(value.path("rss").path("reaped").asBoolean(), "RSS observation child did not reap");
+        require(runtime.path("active_rooms").asInt() <= 64 && runtime.path("active_sessions").asInt() <= 512
+                && runtime.path("pending_input_high_water").asInt() <= 64 && runtime.path("total_input_high_water").asInt() <= 32_768
+                && runtime.path("mailbox_high_water").asInt() <= 1_024 && runtime.path("snapshot_retention_high_water").asInt() <= 32,
+                "actual registry/input/mailbox/retention bounds");
+        JsonNode outbound = runtime.path("outbound");
+        require(outbound.path("control_high_water").asInt() <= 64 && outbound.path("full_high_water").asInt() <= 1
+                && outbound.path("delta_high_water").asInt() <= 1 && outbound.path("transport_per_peer_high_water").asInt() <= 1
+                && outbound.path("superseded_release_errors").asLong() == 0 && outbound.path("cancelled_release_errors").asLong() == 0,
+                "actual outbound high water and original-buffer release bounds");
+        JsonNode udp = runtime.path("udp");
+        require(udp.path("input_high_water").asInt() <= 1_200 && udp.path("output_high_water").asInt() <= 1_200
+                && udp.path("oversize_dropped").asInt() == 0 && udp.path("invalid").asInt() == 0
+                && udp.path("mailbox_dropped").asInt() == 0 && udp.path("outbound_oversize_rejected").asInt() == 0
+                && udp.path("io_errors").asInt() == 0, "fixed real UDP transport bounds");
+        if (runtime.has("rooms")) for (JsonNode room : runtime.withArray("rooms"))
+            require(room.path("mailbox_high_water").asInt() <= 1_024 && room.path("max_mailbox_drain").asInt() <= 64
+                    && room.path("replay_bytes").asInt() <= ReplayLog.MAX_BYTES && !room.path("overloaded").asBoolean()
+                    && room.path("clock").path("max_ticks_per_iteration").asInt() <= 4, "actual independent Room scheduler/work bounds");
+    }

+    private static ObjectNode aliased(ObjectNode request, String player) {
+        ObjectNode safe = request.deepCopy(); safe.remove("session_id"); safe.put("session_alias", player); return safe;

+    private static void checkSlowSocket(Client slow) throws Exception {
+        require(((Deque<?>) ReplayFixture.field(slow.socket, "received")).isEmpty(), "unexpected buffered slow client message");
+        ByteBuffer bytes = ByteBuffer.allocate(1_201); DatagramChannel udp = (DatagramChannel) ReplayFixture.field(slow.socket, "udp");
+        require(udp.receive(bytes) == null, "unexpected slow datagram after actual INPUT_ACK barrier");

+    /** Counts original buffer lifetimes, retaining no completed write or payload objects. */

+        BufferProbe(ArenaServer server, List<LiveRoom> rooms) throws Exception {

+                for (LiveRoom room : rooms) for (Client client : room.clients) {
+                    try { ((Channel) ReplayFixture.field(client.queue, "tcp")).pipeline().addFirst("g14-original-buffer-observer", observer(client)); }
+                    catch (ReflectiveOperationException failure) { throw new IllegalStateException(failure); }
+                }
+            }).get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
+        }
+        private ChannelOutboundHandlerAdapter observer(Client tcpClient) {
+            return new ChannelOutboundHandlerAdapter() {
+                @Override public void write(ChannelHandlerContext context, Object message, ChannelPromise promise) throws Exception {
+                    boolean datagram = tcpClient == null; ByteBuf buffer = datagram ? ((DatagramPacket) message).content() : (ByteBuf) message;
+                    Client client = datagram ? endpoints.get(((DatagramPacket) message).recipient()) : tcpClient;
+                    if (client == null) throw new IOException("unmapped original write endpoint");
+                    String kind;
+                    synchronized (client.queue) {
+                        Object inFlight = ReplayFixture.field(client.queue, "inFlight");
+                        if (inFlight == null || ReplayFixture.field(inFlight, "buffer") != buffer) throw new IOException("original transport ownership missing");
+                        kind = ReplayFixture.field(inFlight, "kind").toString();
+                        if (!withinBounds(client.queue.view())) boundsViolations++;
+                    }
+                    int bytes = buffer.readableBytes(); if (buffer.refCnt() != 1) lifetimeViolations++;
+                    writes++; live++; liveBytes += bytes; highWater = Math.max(highWater, live); bytesHighWater = Math.max(bytesHighWater, liveBytes);
+                    kinds.merge(kind, 1L, Long::sum);
+                    promise.addListener(completion -> {
+                        if (buffer.refCnt() != 0 || !completion.isSuccess()) lifetimeViolations++;
+                        if (!withinBounds(client.queue.view())) boundsViolations++;
+                        completed++; if (completion.isSuccess()) sent++; live--; liveBytes -= bytes;
+                    });
+                    context.write(message, promise);
+                }
+            };
+        }
+        ObjectNode view() {
+            ObjectNode value = Json.MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("observed_writes", writes).put("completed_writes", completed).put("sent_writes", sent)
+                    .put("live_writes", live).put("live_bytes", liveBytes).put("pending_high_water", highWater).put("pending_bytes_high_water", bytesHighWater)
+                    .put("lifetime_violations", lifetimeViolations).put("ownership_bound_violations", boundsViolations)
+                    .put("completed_write_references_retained", 0).put("scope", "after128 initial FULL deliveries through actual shutdown");
+            ObjectNode byKind = value.putObject("by_kind"); kinds.forEach(byKind::put); return value;
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static void failed(ObjectNode result, String phase, Exception failure) {
+        result.withArray("failures").add(phase + ": " + failure.getClass().getName() + ": " + failure.getMessage());
+        java.io.StringWriter trace = new java.io.StringWriter(); failure.printStackTrace(new java.io.PrintWriter(trace));
+        result.withArray("errors").addObject().put("phase", phase).put("trace", trace.toString());
+    }
+    private static void require(boolean condition, String message) throws IOException { if (!condition) throw new IOException(message); }
+}

diff --git a/src/test/java/arena/SnapshotReadiness.java b/src/test/java/arena/SnapshotReadiness.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6e82b59
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/test/java/arena/SnapshotReadiness.java
@@ -0,0 +1,83 @@
+package arena;
+
+import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
+import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
+import io.netty.channel.Channel;
+import java.io.IOException;
+import java.lang.reflect.Field;
+import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
+import java.lang.reflect.Proxy;
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.Deque;
+import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.Map;
+import java.util.function.Supplier;
+
+/** Test runtime only: the actual queue, buffers and dequeue remain production-owned. */
+final class SnapshotReadiness {
+    private final OutboundQueue queue;
+    private final List<ByteBuf> observed = new ArrayList<>();
+    private final Map<ByteBuf, Boolean> seen = new IdentityHashMap<>();
+    private long deniedSnapshotChecks, orderedChecks;
+
+    SnapshotReadiness(OutboundQueue queue) throws Exception {
+        this.queue = queue;
+        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") Supplier<Channel> original = (Supplier<Channel>) ReplayFixture.field(queue, "udp");
+        Channel actual = original.get();
+        Channel readiness = (Channel) Proxy.newProxyInstance(Channel.class.getClassLoader(), new Class<?>[]{Channel.class}, (proxy, method, args) -> {
+            if (method.getName().equals("isWritable") && method.getParameterCount() == 0) {
+                synchronized (queue) {
+                    // Production detach selects ORDERED first. Never grant readiness the real channel lacks.
+                    boolean ordered = !((Deque<?>) ReplayFixture.field(queue, "ordered")).isEmpty();
+                    if (ordered) orderedChecks++;
+                    else if (ReplayFixture.field(queue, "full") != null || ReplayFixture.field(queue, "delta") != null) {
+                        deniedSnapshotChecks++; return false;
+                    }
+                    return actual.isWritable();
+                }
+            }
+            try { return method.invoke(actual, args); }
+            catch (InvocationTargetException failure) { throw failure.getCause(); }
+        });
+        Field source = OutboundQueue.class.getDeclaredField("udp"); source.setAccessible(true);
+        synchronized (queue) { source.set(queue, (Supplier<Channel>) () -> readiness); }
+    }
+
+    ObjectNode sample() throws Exception { return sample(false); }
+
+    ObjectNode sample(boolean includeWire) throws Exception {
+        synchronized (queue) {
+            for (String slot : List.of("full", "delta")) {
+                Object message = ReplayFixture.field(queue, slot); if (message == null) continue;
+                ByteBuf buffer = (ByteBuf) ReplayFixture.field(message, "buffer");
+                if (seen.put(buffer, true) == null) {
+                    if (observed.size() == 300) throw new IOException("fixed slow snapshot observation bound");
+                    if (buffer.refCnt() != 1) throw new IOException("slow pending buffer ownership");
+                    observed.add(buffer); // No ByteBuf.retain: only observe the original lifetime.
+                }
+            }
+            int live = 0, bytes = 0;
+            for (ByteBuf buffer : observed) if (buffer.refCnt() != 0) { live++; bytes += buffer.readableBytes(); }
+            ObjectNode result = queue.view();
+            result.put("snapshot_not_ready_checks", deniedSnapshotChecks).put("ordered_actual_readiness_checks", orderedChecks)
+                    .put("observed_snapshot_buffers", observed.size()).put("observed_live_snapshot_buffers", live)
+                    .put("observed_live_snapshot_bytes", bytes).put("observed_released_snapshot_buffers", observed.size() - live);
+            if (includeWire) {
+                ObjectNode wires = result.putObject("queued_snapshot_wires");
+                for (String slot : List.of("full", "delta")) {
+                    Object message = ReplayFixture.field(queue, slot);
+                    if (message == null) { wires.putNull(slot); continue; }
+                    ByteBuf buffer = (ByteBuf) ReplayFixture.field(message, "buffer");
+                    int reader = buffer.readerIndex(), writer = buffer.writerIndex(); byte[] payload = new byte[buffer.readableBytes()];
+                    buffer.getBytes(reader, payload); // Absolute read leaves production indexes and ownership unchanged.
+                    if (reader != buffer.readerIndex() || writer != buffer.writerIndex()) throw new IOException("snapshot observer moved buffer indexes");
+                    ObjectNode wire = wires.putObject(slot).put("bytes", payload.length).put("reader_index", reader)
+                            .put("writer_index", writer).put("ref_count", buffer.refCnt());
+                    wire.set("wire", Json.read(payload));
+                }
+            }
+            return result;
+        }
+    }
+}

diff --git a/track b/track
index 667e29a..1205c0d 100755
--- a/track
+++ b/track
@@ -12,10 +12,15 @@ case "$command" in
     unit-test) exec ./gradlew --offline --no-daemon test "$@" ;;
     integration-test) exec ./gradlew --offline --no-daemon integrationTest "$@" ;;
     scenario-run|replay-verify)
+        if [ "$command" = scenario-run ]; then
+            case "${1:-}" in
+                G14.json|*/G14.json) exec python3 scripts/g14_release_load.py "$@" ;;
+            esac
+        fi
         java_bin=java
         if [ -n "${JAVA_HOME:-}" ]; then java_bin="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"; fi
         exec "$java_bin" -Dio.netty.leakDetection.level=paranoid -cp "$(cat build/test-runtime-classpath.txt)" arena.ReplayTool "$command" "$@"
         ;;
     server) exec ./build/install/arena-java/bin/arena-java "$command" "$@" ;;
-    *) echo 'usage: ./track build | unit-test | integration-test | scenario-run <scenario.json> <evidence.json> | replay-verify <replay> <evidence> | server <config.json>' >&2; exit 2 ;;
+    *) echo 'usage: ./track build | unit-test | integration-test | scenario-run <scenario.json> <evidence.json> [G14: --ledger <path> --jfr <path>] | replay-verify <replay> <evidence> | server <config.json>' >&2; exit 2 ;;
 esac
